about: Read by AFK Realm (https://github.com/aspollon/AFK-Realm) when it installs the module: it switches off the prewritten chatter of mod-playerbots, which would talk over the language model. Without AFK Realm, set these in playerbots.conf yourself (see README.md).

settings.why: The bots' reports of loot, quests and kills would talk over the language model's chat.
The bots' prewritten random talk in say, yell and the general channels; the language model talks instead.
The bots' random emotes; the module plays emotes that fit what a bot says.
The bots' prewritten dungeon suggestions in the channels.
The bots' prewritten greeting when they are invited.
Bots without a master talking on their own with prewritten lines.
